name: OSV
tagline: Google-backed open-source vulnerability database with package-level queries across ecosystems
description: OSV is a free, open-source vulnerability database and API maintained by Google that provides detailed vulnerability information for packages across multiple ecosystems including npm, PyPI, Maven, Go, crates.io, and more. Developers can query by package name/version or by commit hash to retrieve vulnerability details, severity scores, and affected versions. The API is unauthenticated and free to use with published rate limits.

auth.details: No authentication required. The API is publicly accessible without API keys or signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free with no paid plans; rate limited to 1000 requests/hour for unauthenticated use

rate_limits: 1000 requests per hour (unauthenticated); higher limits available via contact
use_cases: check if a package version has known vulnerabilities
query vulnerabilities by Git commit hash
get vulnerability details by OSV or CVE ID
list affected versions for a security advisory
integrate vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines
